answers_to_your_questions.question: MU FQ4 date conflict: INDmoney feed says 2026-09-30, calendar/yfinance 2026-10-01; 6.03% weight, 5d +13.4% into print.
answers_to_your_questions.answer: The INDmoney date is right and the calendar/yfinance date is the reaction-session date, not the print date. Micron's own IR press release (published 2026-08-26) states the FQ4 earnings call is Wednesday 2026-09-30 at 2:30 p.m. Mountain (= 4:30 p.m. ET, i.e. 30 minutes AFTER the US close). Results therefore land after the bell on 09-30 and the first tradable reaction session is Thursday 2026-10-01, which is what the 10-01 in yfinance/earnings_calendar.json is tracking (source: yfinance, unconfirmed by the company). The IR page does not itself print 'after market close'; the after-close inference rests on the 2:30 MT call time (4:30 ET, past the 4:00 ET close) and the same pattern on FQ3 (call Wed 2026-06-24, 2:30 p.m. MT, release dated the same day). Implication for P-363: the print is 7 trading days away (09-22..09-30), the gap-risk session is 10-01, and nothing prints on 09-30 during regular hours, so a 09-30 close-of-day decision is still made blind to the numbers. Option-implied move (yfinance chain, spot $1040.73 on 2026-09-21, ATM 1040 straddle mid): the 2026-10-02 expiry, the first expiry after the print, prices call mid 50.35 + put mid 55.95 = 106.30 = 10.21% of spot (matches the 10.22% already in memory, so the desk figure stands). That figure includes about 4 non-event trading days of diffusion. Stripping the pre-print variance using the 2026-09-28 expiry straddle (26.0+28.0)/2 + (31.25+33.85)/2 = 59.55 = 5.72% of spot, my variance-decomposition estimate of the earnings-day-only expected absolute move is about 7.2%. Treat 7.2% as a model estimate with a wide error band (wide bid/ask on the 09-28 puts, put skew, IV 45-54% on 09-28 vs 65-75% on 10-02); 10.21% is the directly observed number. I am not recommending a trade; sizing belongs to the strategist. No quarter verdict: FQ4 has not been reported, so quarter_verdict and guide_verdict stay null.
